text:
A new quarter starts **Monday**, and nothing is scheduled to be tested yet. That makes this the rare week where getting ahead costs very little.

Tuesday through Thursday end with Tae Kwon Do, and Friday is Crochet Club, so **Monday** is your open evening once ASL Club finishes. If anything from last quarter is still bothering you, student hours on Tuesday and Thursday are the cheapest way to settle it.

Two new doors: tap any formula on your physics Sheet and its guide opens, and your Wonder Jar is now one tap from this screen.
